text.p: Bowater Inc said Wednesday it will reorganize its U.S. and Canadian forest and wood products operations into a new division to be called forest products.
"The consolidation of these assets into a separate business unit will enable the company to explore new opportunities to improve returns on its forest products assets," it said in a statement.
Bowater said it will also consolidate its newsprint and directory paper businesses into one division.
It did not provide any further details and its officials were not available for comment.
Bowater said it owned or controlled nearly 3.6 million acres of timberland in six U.S. states and Canada as well as three sawmills that produce about two million board feet of lumber annually.
The company is a producer of both newsprint and directory paper in the United States, with manufacturing facilities in Maine, Tennessee, South Carolina and Nova Scotia.
